import numpy as np
from scipy import stats
from sklearn.feature_selection import mutual_info_classif
from sklearn.preprocessing import StandardScaler

MAX_DRIVERS = 2

def design(feats):
    # Calculate effect sizes (mean difference in outcome groups)
    effect_sizes = []
    for i, fid in enumerate(feats.ids):
        y0 = feats.x[feats.y == 0, i]
        y1 = feats.x[feats.y == 1, i]
        effect_size = np.mean(y1) - np.mean(y0)
        effect_sizes.append(abs(effect_size))
    
    # Sort by effect size
    sorted_indices = np.argsort(effect_sizes)[::-1]
    top_features = [feats.ids[i] for i in sorted_indices[:10]]
    
    # Remove near-duplicates based on correlation
    to_remove = set()
    corr_threshold = 0.6
    for i in range(len(top_features)):
        if top_features[i] in to_remove:
            continue
        for j in range(i+1, len(top_features)):
            if top_features[j] in to_remove:
                continue
            fid1, fid2 = top_features[i], top_features[j]
            col1, col2 = feats.column(fid1), feats.column(fid2)
            corr = np.corrcoef(feats.x[:, col1], feats.x[:, col2])[0, 1]
            if abs(corr) >= corr_threshold:
                to_remove.add(fid2)
    
    filtered_features = [f for f in top_features if f not in to_remove]
    
    # Select top 2 features for drivers
    drivers = tuple(filtered_features[:MAX_DRIVERS])
    
    # Use all non-near-duplicate features for regression
    columns = tuple(filtered_features)
    
    # Check for strong correlations to form products
    products = []
    for i in range(len(columns)):
        for j in range(i+1, len(columns)):
            fid1, fid2 = columns[i], columns[j]
            col1, col2 = feats.column(fid1), feats.column(fid2)
            corr = np.corrcoef(feats.x[:, col1], feats.x[:, col2])[0, 1]
            if abs(corr) >= 0.6:
                products.append((fid1, fid2))
    
    # Simple weighted score using top feature
    loadings = {}
    if columns:
        loadings[columns[0]] = 1.0
    
    return Design(drivers=drivers, columns=columns, products=tuple(products), loadings=loadings)
